h:
对于那些想要充分利用 Pony Diffusion V6 XL 的人，我使用 ComfyUI 界面开发了一个全面的工作流程。此工作流程允许您：

  • 创建图像：首先使用 Pony Diffusion V6 XL 生成初始图像。

  • 纠正面部、眼睛和手部错误：使用 ComfyUI 中的特定工具来识别和修复面部、眼睛和手部的常见错误，确保您的角色呈现最佳状态。

  • 放大校正后的图像：进行校正后，放大图像以提高其分辨率和整体质量。

  • 细化放大的图像：放大后，使图像经过细化过程，以纠正放大过程中引入的任何故障或伪影。

  • 使用元数据保存图像：最后，使用与 CivitAI 兼容的元数据保存精炼图像，确保保留所有相关信息以供将来使用或共享。

此工作流程旨在简化您的图像创建过程，以最少的努力提供高质量的结果。无论您是经验丰富的专业人士还是 Pony Diffusion 的新手，Zohac 的 Pony XL 工作流程将帮助您每次都能获得令人惊叹的精美图像。

o.en:
For those who want to get the most out of Pony Diffusion V6 XL, I've developed a comprehensive workflow using the ComfyUI interface. This workflow allows you to:

  • Create an Image: Start by generating your initial image using Pony Diffusion V6 XL.

  • Correct Facial, Eye, and Hand Errors: Use specific tools within ComfyUI to identify and fix common errors in faces, eyes, and hands, ensuring your characters look their best.

  • Upscale the Corrected Image: Once corrections are made, upscale the image to enhance its resolution and overall quality.

  • Refine the Upscaled Image: After upscaling, pass the image through a refining process to correct any glitches or artifacts introduced during upscaling.

  • Save the Image with Metadata: Finally, save the refined image with metadata compatible with CivitAI, ensuring all relevant information is preserved for future use or sharing.

This workflow is designed to streamline your image creation process, providing high-quality results with minimal effort. Whether you're a seasoned pro or new to Pony Diffusion, Zohac's Pony XL Workflow will help you achieve stunning, polished images every time.
